notes: - contradiction: "Theriosuchus is an extinct genus of basal crocodilian known from the Early Cretaceous of Asia and England." / "Theriosuchus was one of the few basal crocodilians present in Laurasia during the Late Cretaceous.": [1] places Theriosuchus in the Early Cretaceous, while [3] states it was present in the Late Cretaceous.
